verdict.rationale: Secureframe ships an official MCP server exposing controls, tests, vendors, frameworks, and risks as MCP tools, which enables natural-language operation via an AI agent/assistant connected to it — a strong signal for agenticness. However, evidence doesn't show a native, first-party chat/NL command interface within the Secureframe product itself, and setup guidance (CI jobs, scripts, no-browser) suggests it's aimed at technical/automation use rather than a polished end-user NL experience. Missing for 10: first-party in-app natural-language interface, hands-on/independent evidence of NL command usage via MCP, broader documentation of supported natural-language operations beyond MCP tool exposure.
